description: This is a shell script used for testing the 'split index' feature in Git. It contains setup procedures, test cases that manipulate the Git index with split index configurations, and validation steps to verify correct behavior of split index functionalities including configuration options, shared index expiration, permissions, and error handling.

methods.name: create_non_racy_file
methods.description: Creates a file with content read from stdin and sets its modification time to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution represented by a specific description string.
